helpIntro: UA undergraduate grades use plus/minus quality points from A+ = 4.33 through F = 0. Enter semester hours and final UA grades to estimate your institutional GPA.
helpNote: This profile calculates the undergraduate institutional UA GPA only. Accepted transfer grades belong to the separate Overall GPA. UA caps the undergraduate cumulative GPA at 4.0 even though A+ earns 4.33 quality points. Repeat Impact is unavailable because every attempt remains in GPA.
helpExample: A 3-credit A+ earns 12.99 quality points and a 3-credit B earns 9.00. Together, 21.99 ÷ 6 = 3.665.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ earns 4.33 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.A: A earns 4.00 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- earns 3.67 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ earns 3.33 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B earns 3.00 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- earns 2.67 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ earns 2.33 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C earns 2.00 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- earns 1.67 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ earns 1.33 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D earns 1.00 quality point per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- earns 0.67 quality points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F earns zero quality points and its GPA hours still count.
gradeExplanations.IN: Incomplete is non-punitive while unresolved; it normally changes to F if not resolved by the deadline.
gradeExplanations.N: No Grade Reported is not used in this undergraduate GPA profile; confirm the final posted grade.
gradeExplanations.NC: No Credit is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.IP: In Progress is excluded until a final grade is posted.
gradeExplanations.NG: Non-Graded Class is excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: UA undergraduate course
specialTypes.note: Enter the final grade and semester hours for coursework completed at The University of Alabama.

specialTypes.name: Accepted transfer course
specialTypes.note: Transfer grades affect the separate Overall GPA, not the institutional UA GPA. Use the official record for Overall GPA questions.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each graded attempt as a separate completed course. The calculator estimates GPA only; it does not determine earned-hour or degree-credit treatment.
